parsed.explanation: This is state-directed targeting of gender-nonconforming people, not mere societal disapproval. A dedicated detention power holds people up to six months without charge on suspicion of 'impersonating the opposite gender' or 'public morality' — a universal, traveller-facing exposure triggered by appearance or document mismatch, and documented arrests in public places based solely on gender expression. Custody brings documented severe repeated beatings, sexual harassment, torture and forced 'conversion therapy'; a reported forced surgical detransition was denied by authorities, so I weight it as contested rather than established. Enforcement demonstrably reaches foreigners: a dual citizen held 44 days and denied counsel and medication, an airline employee detained over appearance, struck, then deported and banned. No working remedy exists; advocacy is criminalised. The unenforced capital same-sex provision and cohabitation law are secondary signals. Severity is tier-1/2 organised state coercion short of documented routine execution, placing this just below the 0.15 anchor tier.
